MEMBER-AT-LARGE           Community Board No. 1 Releases Calendar
                              for Meeting Dates in 2026-2027

                Chairperson Dealice Fuller was pleased to announce that the members of
         Brooklyn Community Board No, 1 approved a calendar for the year 2026-2027. The
         following is a list of dates that meetings are scheduled to occur.

         2026

         Tuesday          01/13                                           2026
         Tuesday          02/10
         Tuesday          03/10                                           Tuesday        01/13
                                                                          Tuesday        02/10
         Tuesday          04/14                                           Tuesday        03/10
         Tuesday          05/12                                           Tuesday        04/14
         Tuesday          06/09                                           Tuesday        05/12
                                   (*Scheduled                            Tuesday        06/09
         *Tuesday         07/14*                                          *Tuesday       07/14*
         *Tuesday         08/11*   if necessary)                          *Tuesday       08/11*
         Tuesday          09/08                                           Tuesday        09/08
                                                                          Tuesday        10/13
         Tuesday          10/13                                           Tuesday        11/10
         Tuesday          11/10                                           Tuesday        12/15
         Tuesday          12/15
                                                                          2027

         2027                                                             Tuesday        01/12
                                                                          Tuesday        02/09
                                                                          Tuesday        03/09
         Tuesday          01/12
         Tuesday          02/09
         Tuesday          03/09

         Ms. Johana P. Pulgarin, District Manager, relayed that Combined Public Hearings and
         Board Meetings are usually held on the second Tuesday of the month at 6:00 PM,
         unless otherwise indicated. All meetings are generally held at the Swinging Sixties
         Senior Center, 211 Ainslie Street, Brooklyn, NY 11211 (Corner of Manhattan Avenue).
         For information regarding this press release please contact District Manager Ms.
         Pulgarin at (718) 389-0009.
          See our website for additional information: https://www.nyc.gov/site/brooklyncb1/index.page
